Name: Vanilla Tweaks - Iridium Recolors Patch
Description:
This mod retextures some items in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21435]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]mrtaiyou[/url] to fit the color choices offered in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4366]Iridium Recolors[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/6480/about-me]6480[/url].

Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4366]Iridium Recolors[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21435]Vanilla Tweaks - Warrior[/url] (for tools and weapons)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21351]Vanilla Tweaks - Cave[/url] (for items)

Make sure to open the config options using Generic Mod Config Menu after installation. You can individually choose which items are recolored.

Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece/about-me?gameId=1303]siamece[/url] for recoloring all of the art in this mod!
Original Vanilla Tweaks sprites are from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]mrtaiyou[/url].
Mod put together by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/6480/about-me]6480[/url], based on coding done by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me?gameId=1303]AirynS[/url] for VT.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Vanilla Tweaks - Iridium Recolors Patch
Manifest.Description: Compatibility patch that combines both Vanilla Tweaks by mrtaiyou and Iridium Recolors by 6480.
